name: Huli jing
description: Huli jing are supernatural fox spirits in Chinese mythology and folklore capable of shapeshifting into human form, ranging from benevolent fox immortals (huxian) to malevolent fox demons (huyao) that drain life essence from human victims.
origin: Fox spirit traditions are distributed across the Sinosphere. The core tradition is Han Chinese, with strong fox-cult belief historically concentrated in northern China (Hebei, Shandong, Shanxi, Manchuria). Cognate traditions extend to Korea (kumiho), Japan (kitsune), and Vietnam (hồ ly tinh).
